product.name: BILLY
product.introText: BILLY bookcase 80x28x202 cm, white. Assembly instructions AA-1823127-9. Two people recommended; work on a soft surface. Tools: Phillips and flat screwdrivers, hammer, pencil, ruler. The bookcase must be fixed to the wall (wall screws not included).
product.partsSummary: 1x Back,  1x Bottom,  2x Bracket,  12x Cam,  12x Cam bolt,  16x Dowel,  1x Fixed shelf,  18x Nail,  1x Plinth,  2x Screw,  4x Shelf,  2x Side,  16x Support,  1x Top,  2x Washer

steps.title: Dowels into the boards
steps.text: Push 16 dowels (101351) into the holes in the ends of the top, the bottom, the fixed shelf and the plinth - 2 at each end.

steps.title: Cam bolts into the sides
steps.text: Screw 12 cam bolts (118331) into the inside of both sides, 6 per side, with a screwdriver.

steps.title: Bottom, plinth and fixed shelf onto the first side
steps.text: Lay one side flat on the floor, holes up. Fit the bottom, the plinth and the fixed shelf onto its dowels and cam bolts. Check the inset: the edge with the holes must face the right way.

steps.title: Lock the bottom and the fixed shelf
steps.text: Put 4 cams (119081) into the holes of the bottom and the fixed shelf, arrow towards the edge, and turn them clockwise to lock them onto the cam bolts.

steps.title: Fit the top
steps.text: Fit the top onto the side the same way and lock it with 2 cams (119081). Check the inset: the holes in the top must face inwards.

steps.title: Second side on top
steps.text: Put the second side onto the dowels and cam bolts from above.

steps.title: Lock the second side
steps.text: Lock the second side with 6 cams (119081), turning each one clockwise.

steps.title: Turn it onto its front and mark the fixed shelf
steps.text: Lay the bookcase on its front. With a pencil, mark the middle of the fixed shelf on the back edges of both sides - you will nail along this line later.

steps.title: Slide in the back panel
steps.text: Unfold the back panel and slide it over the back of the bookcase from the bottom end, smooth side down, until it covers the whole back.

steps.title: Nail on the back panel
steps.text: Draw a line across the back panel between the two marks (use a ruler). Nail the back panel with 18 nails (101201): 6 along the top, 6 along the line of the fixed shelf and 6 along the bottom. The back panel must be flush with the sides - push the bookcase square before nailing.

steps.title: Stand it up and fit the wall brackets
steps.text: Stand the bookcase upright against the wall. Screw the 2 wall brackets (106989) onto the top with the screws (109041) and washers (100823). Fix them to the wall with screws suitable for your wall (not included) - the bookcase must be attached to the wall so it cannot tip over.

steps.title: Shelf supports
steps.text: Push 16 shelf supports (131372) into the holes of the sides at the heights you want - 4 per shelf.

steps.title: Put in the shelves
steps.text: Lay the 4 shelves onto the supports and press them down so the pins of the supports hold them.
